reference: When you select targets before any attacks are resolved, you must ensure that at least one model in the enemy unit is both within range of the weapon (equal to or less than the weapon's Range characteristic) and visible to the attacking model. If you selected more than one target for your unit to shoot at, you must completely resolve all of the attacks against one target before moving on to the next target.
response:
Based on the provided evidence, here are the specific conditions for selecting an enemy unit and how attacks must be resolved:

**Conditions for Selecting an Enemy Unit**
*   **For Ranged Attacks:** At least one model in the target unit must be both within range of the weapon being used (meaning the distance between it and the attacking model is equal to or less than the weapon's Range characteristic) and visible to the attacking model (p. 19).
*   **For Melee Attacks:** The attacking model must be either within Engagement Range of the enemy unit, or in base-to-base contact with another model in its own unit that is itself in base-to-base contact with that enemy unit (p. 34).

**How Attacks Must Be Resolved**
*   You must select targets for all attacks (or all of a unit's ranged weapons) *before* any attacks are resolved (p. 19, p. 34).
*   When selecting targets, you must declare which models will target which units with which weapons (and choose weapon profiles if applicable) before any attacks are resolved (p. 19, p. 34).

WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

[DISEMBARK | page 17]
- ■ - Units that start your Movement phase embarked within a Transport can disembark this phase, provided their Transport has not Advanced or Fallen Back.
- ■ - If a unit disembarks before its Transport moves, it can act normally.
- ■ - If a unit disembarks after its Transport moves, it cannot move or charge this turn, but can otherwise act normally.
- ■ - Disembarking units must be set up wholly within 3" of their Transport and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models (or the unit cannot disembark).
- ■ - Units that disembark this turn cannot Remain Stationary.

[ADVANCE MOVES | page 14]
When a unit Advances, make an Advance roll for that unit by rolling one D6. Add the result in inches to the Move characteristic of each model in that unit until the end of the phase. Each model in that unit can then make an Advance move by moving a distance in inches less than or equal to this total, but no model can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy models. A unit cannot shoot or declare a charge in the same turn that it Advanced.
- ■ Advance Move: Models move up to M+D6".
- ■ - Cannot move within Engagement Range of any enemy models.
- ■ - Units that Advance cannot shoot or charge this turn.
